offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based human capital management software for small and mid-sized businesses, covering payroll, tax filing, time and attendance, HR, and talent management. Sold mainly through direct sales and partners, delivered as software-as-a-service with related services.

primary_products.value: payroll software; time and attendance software and clocks; HR software; talent management software; benefits administration software

primary_services.value: payroll tax filing; HR compliance support; benefits administration; implementation and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses and their HR and payroll teams, across many industries

end_markets.value: cross-industry employers; professional services; healthcare; retail; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring per-employee fees for cloud payroll, HR, and time software; service fees: payroll tax filing, implementation, and outsourced HR services; product sales: time and attendance hardware clocks; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held before tax remittance
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; product sales; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud HCM platform sold to small and mid-sized employers; service provider: payroll tax filing and HR support for client businesses

geography_served.value: North America: primarily United States, with some customers in Canada, UK and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, time and attendance, talent management, and benefits administration software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to small and mid-sized businesses; partners / resellers: channel partners, payroll providers, and benefits brokers reselling the platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and employment rules, data privacy, and ERISA/ACA benefits compliance, state and IRS requirements
